description.value: Ga Taa Naay Restaurant is a dining venue housed within the Haida Heritage Centre at Ḵay Llnagaay, an award-winning Aboriginal cultural tourism complex in Skidegate on Haida Gwaii, British Columbia's remote northwest coast. The 50,000-square-foot centre encompasses a museum, carving shed, canoe house, performance house, and gift shop, all designed to resemble a traditional oceanside Haida village. Touring cyclists arriving here will find themselves at one of BC's most distinctive cultural destinations, far off the typical mainland circuit.
